contracts.prompt_snippet: MACHINE CONTRACT (required): emit one fenced ```release-checklist-json``` object with items, go_no_go, and rollback. Every item names owner, prerequisite, evidence, and blocking status; rollback names triggers and authority. Describe verification but do not claim it ran.

MACHINE CONTRACT (required): emit one fenced ```runbook-json``` object with signals, procedures, rollback, and escalation. Every step states its precondition, expected evidence, failure branch, and owner; unsupported commands or thresholds must be marked unresolved.

MACHINE CONTRACT (required): emit one fenced ```postmortem-json``` object with timeline, impact, contributing_conditions, actions, and follow_ons. Facts cite evidence, hypotheses are labeled, actions name owner and verification, and follow_ons are suitable inputs for the existing portfolio project-minting workflow.
